purpose: Readiness matrix for source-evidence review across cluster-dynamics benchmark and theory branches.

readiness_rows.name: Bullet Cluster offset benchmark package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The Bullet Cluster working copy has a real source label, but archival pointer and transcription audit are not yet frozen.

readiness_rows.name: Bullet Cluster dimensional calibration package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The current verifier checks only separation sign and has no calibrated kpc magnitude model.

readiness_rows.name: Virial and mass-temperature benchmark package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: Secondary virial and mass-temperature datasets exist but are not yet primary-gated with dedicated artifacts.

readiness_rows.name: Information-halo grid engine package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: The information-halo engine remains a model-unit diagnostic without physical lensing calibration.

readiness_rows.name: Cluster dark-matter replacement package
readiness_rows.blocking_reason: There is no held-out multi-cluster package or lensing-map comparison that would support a dark-matter replacement claim.

claim_boundary: A ready row has enough provenance structure for source review. It does not by itself upgrade cluster or dark-matter claims.
